name: Ittai
overview: The figure of Ittai the Gittite in 2 Samuel 15 demonstrates loyal devotion and steadfast support for King David during a time of crisis. Though a foreigner and recent arrival, Ittai pledges unwavering allegiance to David, declaring he will remain wherever the king goes, whether in life or death. David’s acceptance of Ittai and his men underscores the value of faithful commitment to God's anointed, even from those outside Israel’s native community.
